import bpy
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['surface_pass_20261113']
exec(r'''
assert not craft.get('surface_pass_metal')
# Existing 4x4 sheet UV atlas is retained. Each region has its own corrosion history.
TW,TH=256,512
v,u=np.mgrid[0:TH,0:TW].astype(np.float32)/np.array([TH-1,TW-1],np.float32)[:,None,None]
rgb=np.zeros((TH*4,TW*4,3),np.float32);height=np.zeros(rgb.shape[:2],np.float32)
rough=np.zeros_like(height);metal=np.zeros_like(height);stats=[]
for k in range(16):
 wall=k>=8;seed=9313+k*113
 wash=noise(u,v,3,5,seed);meso=noise(u,v,12,27,seed+1);chip=noise(u,v,47,86,seed+2)
 # Asymmetric seam wear, interrupted end rust, and a few sheet-specific paint losses.
 boundary=np.full((TH,TW),-.4,np.float32)
 if k%4!=1:boundary=np.maximum(boundary,.015+.030*wash+.023*(meso-.5)-u)
 if k%3==0:boundary=np.maximum(boundary,.018+.028*meso-(1-u))
 ends=.028+.095*noise(u,v,5,3,seed+7)+.020*(meso-.5)
 if k%5==1:ends*=.45
 boundary=np.maximum(boundary,ends-v)
 centers=[(.14+.1*(k%4),.27+.11*(k%3),.10+.035*(k%2),.09+.04*(k%3))]
 if not wall:centers.append((.69-.10*(k%3),.63+.035*(k%4),.12+.03*(k%2),.22))
 if k%4==2:centers.append((.83,.40,.06,.08))
 for cx,cy,rx,ry in centers:
  d=1-((u-cx)/rx)**2-((v-cy)/ry)**2
  boundary=np.maximum(boundary,.10*d+.022*(meso-.5)+.014*(chip-.5))
 rust=smooth(-.002,.004,boundary)
 fringe=smooth(-.009,-.003,boundary)*(1-rust)
 base=np.array([.326,.390,.413] if wall else [.29,.348,.379])+[-.013,.008,.017,-.007][k%4]
 c=np.broadcast_to(base,(TH,TW,3)).copy()
 c+=(wash[:,:,None]-.5)*np.array([.070,.072,.071])+(meso[:,:,None]-.5)*.012
 oxide=np.array([.425,.246,.140])+(wash[:,:,None]-.5)*np.array([.15,.11,.066])+(meso[:,:,None]-.5)*.022
 c=c*(1-rust[:,:,None])+oxide*rust[:,:,None]
 c=c*(1-fringe[:,:,None]*.35)+np.array([.32,.28,.23])*fringe[:,:,None]*.35
 # Thin bare scratches at selected folds; exposed steel is separate from paint and oxide.
 bare=np.zeros((TH,TW),np.float32)
 if k%3==1:
  bare=np.exp(-((u-(.976 if k%2 else .024))/.0035)**2)*smooth(.15,.3,v)*(1-smooth(.66,.86,v))
 bare*=1-rust
 c=c*(1-bare[:,:,None])+np.array([.42,.44,.435])*bare[:,:,None]
 # Faint runoff is short, patch-dependent and always in the sheet drainage direction.
 for j,cx in enumerate([.085,.915]):
  tail=np.exp(-((u-cx-(meso-.5)*.007)/.006)**2)*np.exp(-((v-(.78-.055*(k%3)))/.10)**2)*(.3+.7*wash)
  c-=tail[:,:,None]*np.array([.023,.022,.019])
 s=np.s_[(k//4)*TH:(k//4+1)*TH,(k%4)*TW:(k%4+1)*TW]
 rgb[s]=np.clip(c,0,1)
 height[s]=(meso-.5)*.00009-rust*.00012+(chip-.5)*rust*.00022
 rough[s]=(.60 if wall else .56)+wash*.11+rust*.19-bare*.18
 metal[s]=.02*(1-rust)+.008*rust+.65*bare
 stats.append({'tile':k,'role':'wall' if wall else 'roof','rust_fraction':round(float(np.mean(rust>.5)),3)})
sheet=surface('SP13_WeatheredBlueSteel',rgb,height,rough,metal,(.96*4,4.0*4),.65)
N=512;v,u=np.mgrid[0:N,0:N].astype(np.float32)/N
b=noise(u,v,4,6,399);m=noise(u,v,28,35,391);r=smooth(.67,.83,b)
rgb=np.array([.248,.294,.308])+(b[:,:,None]-.5)*.045
rgb=rgb*(1-r[:,:,None])+np.array([.38,.225,.14])*r[:,:,None]
iron=surface('SP13_ForgedEdgeIron',rgb,(m-.5)*.00008,.59+.15*b,.48*(1-r)+.015*r,(1,1),.55)
paint=bpy.data.materials['Shipyard_Painterly_BlueSaltPaint'].copy();paint.name='SP13_BluePaintJoinery'
for node in paint.node_tree.nodes:
 if node.type=='TEX_IMAGE' and node.image and 'albedo' in node.image.name.lower():
  # A dedicated plain atlas agrees with the metal while keeping the existing joinery grain maps.
  N=1024;vv,uu=np.mgrid[0:N,0:N].astype(np.float32)/N
  b=noise(uu,vv,5,5,833);w=noise(uu,vv,61,8,834)
  arr=np.array([.31,.366,.378])+(b[:,:,None]-.5)*.044+(w[:,:,None]-.5)*.008
  node.image=png('SP13_BluePaintJoinery_albedo',arr,True)
 if node.type=='NORMAL_MAP':node.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.22
mapping={'Shipyard_Painterly_RivetedSheetSteel':sheet,'Shipyard_Painterly_HeavyOxideIron':iron,'Shipyard_Painterly_BlueSaltPaint':paint}
counts={}
for o in craft.objects:
 if o.type=='MESH' and o.data.materials and o.data.materials[0].name in mapping:
  old=o.data.materials[0].name;assign(o,mapping[old]);counts[old]=counts.get(old,0)+1
craft['surface_pass_metal']=True
(cap/'metal_pass.json').write_text(json.dumps({'objects':counts,'atlas':stats,'source_uv_preserved':True,'geometry_corrugation_unchanged':True},indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('SP13_METAL',counts,stats)
''',ns)
